name: Asymmetric Price Decoys
scenario: Structuring commercial SaaS pricing tiers for an enterprise customer.
script: "Tier 1 provides core API access for $100,000. Tier 2 provides core API access plus dedicated 24/7 technical support for $240,000. Tier 3 provides core API access, dedicated 24/7 support, unlimited custom connectors, and full disaster-recovery insurance for $250,000."
defense: Expose the decoy: Tier 2 is unviable on purpose; strip insurance and extra connectors and price Tier 2 at $135,000.
originFull: The Asymmetric Dominance Effect (Decoy Effect) proves that introducing a third, asymmetrically dominated option shifts consumer preferences toward the target option by making it look overwhelmingly superior in value.
defenseFull: Expose the decoy architecture: "Tier 2 is configured as an unviable decoy to funnel our team into Tier 3. Strip the insurance and extra connectors, and provide Tier 2 at an adjusted market price of $135,000."
